Responsive image

Use .img-fluid class to the img tag to get responsive image.

<div class="text-center">
<img src="./assets/images/media/media-42.jpg" class="img-fluid" alt="...">
</div>
Image With Radius

Use .rounded class along with .img-fluid to get border radius.

<div class="text-center">
<img src="./assets/images/media/media-43.jpg" class="img-fluid rounded" alt="...">
</div>
Rounded Image

Use .rounded-pill class to img tag to get rounded image.

<div class="text-center">
<img src="./assets/images/media/media-44.jpg" class="img-fluid rounded-pill" alt="...">
</div>
Image Left Align
<img class="rounded float-start" src="./assets/images/media/media-47.jpg" alt="...">
Image Center Align
<img class="rounded mx-auto d-block" src="./assets/images/media/media-49.jpg" alt="...">
Image Right Align
<img class="rounded float-end" src="./assets/images/media/media-48.jpg" alt="...">
Figures 
<figure class="figure">
<img class="bd-placeholder-img figure-img img-fluid rounded card-img" src="./assets/images/media/media-50.jpg" alt="...">
<figcaption class="figure-caption">A caption for the above image.
</figcaption>
</figure>
<figure class="figure float-end">
<img class="bd-placeholder-img figure-img img-fluid rounded card-img" src="./assets/images/media/media-51.jpg" alt="...">
<figcaption class="figure-caption text-end">A caption for the above image.
</figcaption>
</figure>
Image Thumbnail

Use .img-thumbnail to give an image a rounded 1px border.

<div class="text-center">
<img src="./assets/images/media/media-45.jpg" class="img-thumbnail" alt="...">
</div>
Rounded Thumbnail

Use .rounded-pill along with .img-thummbnail to get radius.

<div class="text-center">
<img src="./assets/images/media/media-46.jpg" class="img-thumbnail rounded-pill" alt="...">
</div>
